完整表述: Across extensive experiments on CIFAR-100, TinyImageNet, and CIFAR-10 using standard architectures and a broad set of unstructured sparsification methods, sparse neural networks trained on challenging samples often achieve test accuracy that matches or surpasses the corresponding dense models at particular overall sparsity ratios in the 10%–90% range.

label: assertion
text: This behavior is observed for clean test accuracy

label: assertion
text: When training data are scarce sparse neural networks tend to outperform dense counterparts more markedly than in the full-data regime
完整表述: When training data are scarce (where the data ratio, the fraction of the challenging subset used for training, is reduced from the full set), sparse neural networks tend to outperform dense counterparts more markedly than in the full-data regime.

label: assertion
text: the advantage being most pronounced at higher overall sparsity levels in the reported experiments.
完整表述: When training data are scarce, the advantage of sparse neural networks over dense counterparts is most pronounced at higher overall sparsity levels in the reported experiments.

label: assertion
text: Under adversarial training with Projected Gradient Descent (PGD), sparse models at high sparsity achieve comparable clean test accuracy
完整表述: Under adversarial training with Projected Gradient Descent (PGD), sparse models at high sparsity achieve comparable clean test accuracy compared to dense models on the examined benchmarks (VGG16 on CIFAR-10 and ResNet18 on CIFAR-100).

label: assertion
text: superior adversarial test accuracy compared to dense models on the examined benchmarks .
完整表述: Under adversarial training with Projected Gradient Descent (PGD), sparse models at high sparsity achieve superior adversarial test accuracy compared to dense models on the examined benchmarks (VGG16 on CIFAR-10 and ResNet18 on CIFAR-100).

label: assertion
text: This trend holds at both full and reduced data volumes .
完整表述: This trend, described in 【1, 8】, holds at both full and reduced data volumes tested in the paper.

label: assertion
text: Sparse methods that allocate higher relative density to early layers —tend to yield higher test accuracy on hard-sample training than uniform per-layer pruning.
完整表述: Sparse methods that allocate higher relative density (proportion of non-zero weights) to early (shallower) layers tend to yield higher test accuracy on hard-sample training than uniform per-layer pruning.

label: assertion
text: When training on inputs corrupted by common visible degradations at a training data ratio of 0.3 , the relative benefit of sparse neural networks over dense models grows as corruption severity increases from low to moderate levels
完整表述: When training on inputs corrupted by common visible degradations, using 30% of the corrupted subset (a training data ratio of 0.3), the relative benefit of sparse neural networks (SNNs) over dense models grows as corruption severity increases from low to moderate levels (severity 2 to severity 4 on the 1–6 scale).

label: assertion
